title: EROC IPO lockup ends — ERock, 180 days after its 2026-06-09 prospectus
source: SEC: 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2110029/000119312526265898/d12401d424b4.htm, read in full 2026-11-06 (first discovered by scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs 2026-10-20). Prospectus dated 2026-06-09 (cover: 'Prospectus Dated June 9, 2026'); the Underwriting section sets one 'Restricted Period' of 180 days after that date, so the last locked day is 2026-12-06 (a Sunday) and the first session insiders may sell is Monday 2026-12-07. The '30 days' the earlier estimate read is the underwriters' over-allotment option, not a lock-up period (the Q2 10-Q shows it was never exercised: 48,174,023 Class A outstanding = 20,267,046 pre-IPO + 27,906,977 sold). No earnings, price or blackout trigger releases anyone early; the only early path is Morgan Stanley's written consent for the underwriters. The Q2 10-Q (filed 2026-08-12) and the EDGAR filing list through 2026-11-06 show no amendment. Lock-up clause: 'the holders of substantially all of our Class A and Class B common stock have agreed not to sell any shares of Class A common stock or securities convertible into or exercisable or exchangeable for Class A common stock for a period of 180 days from the date of this prospectus'
notes: $600M offering, all primary (27.9M shares at $21.50). Up-C: the locked supply is 20.3M Class A shares plus 171.2M Class B units exchangeable one for one. Insiders may sell from the next session; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then.
